name: 核心系统视图详解诊断
description: PostgreSQL 的核心系统视图（pg_stat_user_tables、pg_stat_activity、pg_stat_bgwriter、pg_stat_database、pg_stat_replication 及各 progress 视图）提供全方位的运行状态信息。理解每个字段的精确含义是准确诊断问题的基础。

signals.desc: track_activities 或 track_counts 未开启
统计信息最近被重置，数据样本不足

skip_when.desc: 所有统计功能已开启且数据充足

root_causes.name: 统计收集参数未开启
root_causes.desc: track_activities、track_counts、track_io_timing 等参数未开启，无法收集必要的性能数据。

root_causes.name: 统计信息被意外重置
root_causes.desc: pg_stat_reset() 被调用后所有统计归零，无法判断历史趋势。需要等待足够时间重新积累。

root_causes.name: 关键视图字段误读
root_causes.desc: 如把 pg_stat_user_tables.seq_scan 当作'正在扫描'而非累计值，或忽略 pg_stat_activity.backend_xmin 对 VACUUM 的影响。

root_causes.name: 监控覆盖不全
root_causes.desc: 只看 pg_stat_activity 不看 pg_stat_bgwriter（checkpoint 压力）、不看 pg_stat_archiver（WAL 归档）、不看 pg_stat_replication（复制延迟）。

step1_stats_settings.sql: SELECT name, setting FROM pg_settings WHERE name IN ('track_activities', 'track_counts', 'track_io_timing', 'track_wal_io_timing', 'track_functions') ORDER BY name

step2_database_overview.sql: SELECT datname, numbackends, xact_commit, xact_rollback, blks_read, blks_hit, ROUND(100.0 * blks_hit / GREATEST(blks_read + blks_hit, 1), 2) AS hit_pct, tup_returned, tup_fetched, tup_inserted, tup_updated, tup_deleted, temp_files, pg_size_pretty(temp_bytes) AS temp_size, deadlocks, stats_reset FROM pg_stat_database WHERE datname NOT LIKE 'template%'

step3_bgwriter_checkpoint.sql: SELECT checkpoints_timed, checkpoints_req, checkpoint_write_time, checkpoint_sync_time, buffers_checkpoint, buffers_clean, maxwritten_clean, buffers_backend, buffers_backend_fsync, buffers_alloc, stats_reset FROM pg_stat_bgwriter

step4_table_stats.sql: SELECT schemaname, relname, seq_scan, seq_tup_read, idx_scan, idx_tup_fetch, n_tup_ins, n_tup_upd, n_tup_del, n_live_tup, n_dead_tup, last_vacuum, last_autovacuum, last_analyze, last_autoanalyze FROM pg_stat_user_tables ORDER BY n_dead_tup DESC LIMIT 20

step5_replication_stats.sql: SELECT pid, application_name, client_addr, state, sync_state, sent_lsn, write_lsn, flush_lsn, replay_lsn, write_lag, flush_lag, replay_lag FROM pg_stat_replication

step6_progress_views.desc: 查看正在进行的操作进度
step6_progress_views.sql: SELECT 'vacuum' AS operation, * FROM pg_stat_progress_vacuum UNION ALL SELECT 'create_index', * FROM pg_stat_progress_create_index UNION ALL SELECT 'analyze', * FROM pg_stat_progress_analyze LIMIT 10

step1_track_check.desc: 检查统计采集是否开启
step1_track_check.sql: SELECT name, setting, CASE WHEN setting = 'on' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_enabled FROM pg_settings WHERE name IN ('track_activities', 'track_counts', 'track_io_timing', 'track_wal_io_timing', 'track_functions') ORDER BY name

decision_tree.step: Step 1: 检查统计采集配置

branches.label: 统计配置已获取
findings: 检查 track_activities、track_counts、track_io_timing 是否全部开启

branches.label: 概览数据已获取
findings: 检查 hit_pct、deadlocks、temp_files 等关键指标

branches.label: 无概览数据
findings: 数据库概览查询无结果

decision_tree.step: Step 3: 检查 bgwriter/checkpoint 统计

branches.label: 统计已获取
findings: 检查 buffers_backend 占比是否过高

branches.label: 表统计已获取
findings: 检查 dead tuple 最多的表

caused_by.name: 监控工具
caused_by.relationship: 监控工具未正确配置导致系统视图数据未被采集和利用

caused_by.name: 内存配置
caused_by.relationship: shared_buffers 配置不当导致 pg_stat_bgwriter 中 buffers_backend 占比异常

causes_of.name: 慢查询分析
causes_of.relationship: 系统视图统计不准确影响慢查询诊断的准确性

version_specific_notes.12: pg_stat_progress_create_index 新增。recovery.conf 改为 postgresql.conf 参数
version_specific_notes.13: pg_stat_statements 新增 planning 统计。pg_stat_progress_basebackup 新增
version_specific_notes.14: pg_stat_wal 新增（WAL 生成统计）。pg_stat_progress_copy 新增
version_specific_notes.15: pg_stat_bgwriter 拆分为 pg_stat_bgwriter + pg_stat_checkpointer。pg_stat_subscription_stats 新增
version_specific_notes.16: pg_stat_io 新增（详细 I/O 统计）。last_seq_scan/last_idx_scan 字段新增
version_specific_notes.17: pg_stat_progress_vacuum 增加更多进度信息。系统视图持续增强

real_world_examples.scenario: 未开启 track_io_timing 导致无法分析 I/O 瓶颈
real_world_examples.symptoms: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) 显示大量 buffer reads 但无 I/O timing 数据
real_world_examples.resolution: ALTER SYSTEM SET track_io_timing = on; SELECT pg_reload_conf();
real_world_examples.result: EXPLAIN 输出包含 I/O 时间，精确定位到磁盘读取瓶颈

real_world_examples.scenario: buffers_backend 占比 40% 导致写入抖动
real_world_examples.symptoms: 写入 TPS 不稳定，pg_stat_bgwriter 显示 buffers_backend 占总写入 40%
real_world_examples.root_cause: bgwriter_lru_maxpages 默认 100 太低，后端进程频繁自己刷脏页
real_world_examples.result: buffers_backend 占比降到 5%，写入 TPS 稳定
